analysis.retentionHint: Tip: StarRocks periodically cleans up Profile data, so detailed analysis may no longer be available for older queries.

summary.title: Overview
summary.incomplete: Profile data is incomplete; some metrics may be missing
summary.plannerTotalTime: Total time spent generating the query plan
summary.resultRows: Number of result rows returned to the client
summary.resultBytes: Size of result data returned to the client

metrics.Total: Total time consumed by the query, including planning, execution, and profiling
metrics.QueryState: Query state: Finished, Error, or Running
metrics.DefaultDb: Default database used by the query
metrics.Variables: Important variables used by the query
metrics.NonDefaultSessionVariables: Non-default session variables used by the query
metrics.FrontendProfileMergeTime: Profile processing time on the FE
metrics.QueryCpuTime: Cumulative CPU time of the query, summed across all concurrent processes, so it can exceed the actual execution time
metrics.QueryCumulativeOperatorTime: Total time of all Operators; the denominator of Operator time percentages
metrics.OperatorTime: Cumulative execution time of all Operators
metrics.QueryCumulativeNetworkTime: Total network time of Exchange nodes
metrics.QueryNetworkTime: Sum of network transfer time of all Exchange nodes
metrics.QueryCumulativeScanTime: Total IO time of Scan nodes
metrics.QueryScanTime: Sum of scan time of all Scan nodes
metrics.SpillBytes: Amount of data spilled to disk
metrics.FragmentInstancePrepareTime: Duration of the Fragment prepare phase
metrics.InstanceAllocatedMemoryUsage: Total memory allocated by the instance
metrics.InstanceDeallocatedMemoryUsage: Total memory deallocated by the instance
metrics.DriverTotalTime: Total time consumed by the Driver. DriverTotalTime = ActiveTime + PendingTime + ScheduleTime
metrics.PendingTime: Time the Driver waits for input or unmet preconditions
metrics.InputEmptyTime: Time waiting due to empty input
metrics.FirstInputEmptyTime: Time waiting for the first input
metrics.OutputFullTime: Time waiting due to full output
metrics.Depth: Depth of the node in the execution tree
metrics.IsHotspot: Whether the node is a hotspot
metrics.BlockByInputEmpty: Times blocked due to empty input
metrics.BlockByOutputFull: Times blocked due to full output
metrics.BlockByPrecondition: Times blocked due to unmet preconditions
metrics.YieldByLocalWait: Times yielded due to local wait
metrics.YieldByTimeLimit: Times yielded due to time limit
metrics.EnableEventScheduler: Whether the event scheduler is enabled
metrics.BackendProfileMergeTime: Profile merge time on the BE
metrics.OperatorTotalTime: Total time consumed by the Operator
metrics.PushRowNum: Cumulative output rows of the Operator
metrics.PullRowNum: Cumulative input rows of the Operator
metrics.PullChunkNum: Cumulative input Chunks of the Operator
metrics.PushChunkNum: Cumulative output Chunks of the Operator
metrics.PeakMemoryUsage: Peak memory usage of the Operator
metrics.TimePercentage: Percentage of total time spent in this Operator
metrics.OutputChunkBytes: Bytes of Chunks output by the Operator
metrics.IsSubordinate: Whether this is a subordinate Operator
metrics.SetFinishingTime: Time spent setting the finishing state
metrics.Rollup: Name of the materialized view or Rollup used
metrics.ScanTime: Cumulative Scan time; Scan operations run in the async I/O thread pool
metrics.RawRowsRead: Number of raw rows actually scanned
metrics.IOTimeLocalDisk: I/O time reading data from the local cache
metrics.IOTimeRemote: I/O time reading data from OSS
metrics.SegmentRuntimeZoneMapFilterRows: Rows filtered by Runtime Zone Map
metrics.ZoneMapIndexFilterRows: Rows filtered by Zone Map index
metrics.GetDeltaColumnGroup: Time to get delta column groups
metrics.CompressedBytesReadLocalDisk: Compressed data read from the compute node's local cache
metrics.CompressedBytesReadRemote: Total compressed data read from OSS
metrics.AdaptiveIOTasks: Whether adaptive IO tasks are enabled
metrics.RemainingRowsAfterShortKeyFilter: Rows remaining after Short Key filtering
metrics.PartType: Data distribution mode: UNPARTITIONED, RANDOM, HASH_PARTITIONED, or BUCKET_SHUFFLE_HASH_PARTITIONED
metrics.WaitTime: Wait time caused by a full sender queue
metrics.SortType: Sort mode: full sort or Top N
metrics.BuildingTime: Time spent maintaining internal data structures during sorting
metrics.MergingTime: Time spent merging sorted runs during sorting
metrics.OutputTime: Time spent building the sorted output sequence
metrics.Limit: Limit on the number of rows returned
metrics.StreamingBatchSize: Size of data processed per merge operation in streaming mode
metrics.LateMaterializationMaxBufferChunkNum: Maximum number of buffered Chunks when late materialization is enabled
metrics.OverallStageCount: Total execution count of all stages
metrics.OverallStageTime: Total execution time of each stage
metrics.LateMaterializationGenerateOrdinalTime: Time spent generating ordinal columns during late materialization
metrics.SortedRunProviderTime: Time spent retrieving data from providers in the Process stage
metrics.Type: Local Exchange type: Passthrough, Partition, or Broadcast
metrics.ShuffleNum: Number of shuffles; only valid when Type is Partition
metrics.LocalExchangePeakBufferChunkNum: Peak number of Chunks in the buffer
metrics.LocalExchangePeakBufferRowNum: Peak number of rows in the buffer
metrics.LocalExchangePeakBufferBytes: Peak data size in the buffer
metrics.LocalExchangePeakBufferChunkSize: Peak Chunk size in the buffer
metrics.LocalExchangePeakBufferChunkRowNum: Peak rows per Chunk in the buffer
metrics.LocalExchangePeakBufferChunkBytes: Peak data size per Chunk in the buffer
metrics.IndexNum: Number of synchronous materialized views created for the target table
metrics.RowsFiltered: Rows filtered out due to insufficient data quality
metrics.RowsReturned: Rows written to the target table
metrics.RpcClientSideTime: Total load RPC time recorded on the client side
metrics.RpcServerSideTime: Total load RPC time recorded on the server side
metrics.PrepareDataTime: Total time of the data preparation phase, including format conversion and data quality checks
metrics.SendDataTime: Local time spent sending data, including serialization, compression, and submitting tasks to the sender queue
metrics.IO: Sum of IO time of all Scan nodes
metrics.Processing: Total time the Operator spends on computation
metrics.IoSeekTime: Total IO seek time; only applies to shared-data clusters
metrics.LocalDiskReadIOTime: I/O time reading data from the local cache; only applies to shared-data clusters
metrics.RemoteReadIOTime: I/O time reading data from remote OSS; only applies to shared-data clusters
